verified: CNBC reported, citing a person familiar with the matter, that Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share on Wednesday, above the $70-$78 marketed range.
unconfirmed: the resulting valuation figures ($1.4 trillion previously targeted, roughly $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis), since they come from the same single unnamed source and no official Anthropic or underwriter announcement is quoted; the report also leaves out the number of shares sold, total proceeds, and when the stock begins trading.

verified: CNBC 报道称，其从一位知情人士处获悉 Anthropic 周三将发行价定为每股 83 美元，高于 70 至 78 美元的推介区间。
unconfirmed: Anthropic 官方尚未确认定价、约 1.5 万亿美元的完全稀释估值以及募资总额，这些均依赖单一匿名消息源；报道也未给出具体上市交易所、首个交易日安排与承销商超额配售（绿鞋）规模。

titles.en: Anthropic reportedly prices IPO at $83 a share, above marketed range
titles.zh: Anthropic IPO 据报定价每股 83 美元，高于发行区间，CNBC 报道
